# Ilia Iliadi — Full-Stack & Web Engineer

> Ilia Iliadi is a full-stack web developer based in Tbilisi, Georgia. He builds fast,
> responsive web applications and interactive motion interfaces with Angular, TypeScript,
> C#/ASP.NET Web API and GSAP. Available for freelance and remote work.

Full-stack developer working primarily in Angular and TypeScript, with a focus on
scroll-driven motion, WebGL interfaces and web performance. Studying at IT STEP Academy
Georgia and competing in programming olympiads and hackathons.

## Technical stack

- Frontend: Angular (standalone components, signals, SSR), TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, RxJS, Tailwind CSS
- Graphics and motion: GSAP (ScrollTrigger, timelines), Lenis, WebGL, Canvas 2D
- Backend and tooling: C#, ASP.NET Web API, Node.js, Python, SQL, Git, Netlify
- Practices: responsive design, web performance, accessibility, algorithmic problem solving

## Experience

- 2024 — Present: Freelance Web Developer (self-employed). Custom web applications for local
  businesses and individual clients, focused on responsive design, scroll motion and performance.
- 2023 — Present: Competitive programmer. Hackathon and computer-science olympiad competitor,
  with 1st place finishes in team programming challenges.
- 2022 — Present: Software development student at IT STEP Academy Georgia — a three-year
  full-stack program covering computer science, databases, modern web frameworks and OOP.

## Projects

- [Pulp Tbilisi](https://pulptbilisi.netlify.app/): Web application for Pulp, a specialty coffee
  house and wine bar in Vera, Tbilisi. Responsive UI, custom menu layouts, smooth navigation.
  Built with Angular, TypeScript, REST API, GSAP and a custom database schema. 2026.
